shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: player-configurable 1-3 sky levels above (each a shrinking-ledge mountain) + surface + solid rock basement, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/needs/medical/prisoners, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF, Rimefeller) across the whole column, stairs/ladders/elevators, level-switch UI, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels: the surface, one solid-rock basement below, and a PLAYER-CONFIGURABLE 1-3 sky levels above (setting `maxUpperLevels`, default 1, hard-clamped to 3). Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from a sky level with a live view of the level directly below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED across all four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive**: ALL soft-compat activity checks go through ABDetect.Active (ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier ignorePostfix).
- **HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch]**: only annotated classes reach CreateClassProcessor. GetTypes guarded against ReflectionTypeLoadException.
- **1.6 render-queue model (MEASURED, run #135)**: TerrainHard base 2000; terrain MATERIAL queue = base + renderPrecedence; Cutout atlas 2900; EdgeShadow 2950. Custom map geometry placed via QUEUE + DEPTH levers. In user lore (textures).
- **Level cap is now a setting, not a constant**: up to `maxUpperLevels` (1-3) sky levels + surface + one basement. The old hard cap of one-up/one-down was lifted in FOUR gates (LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate, Building_ABStairs.EstablishLink, Building_ABElevator.AddDirection, PlaceWorker_ABStairs) all reading ABMod.Settings.MaxUpper. Default 1 preserves prior behavior and old saves. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- **Construction placement is left VANILLA**: building over natural rock is rejected everywhere (vanilla lock, not patched). Players mine basement/sky rooms out first, then wall the boundaries.

## Stacked sky levels (NEW — configurable 1-3 up)
- **Relative-neighbour architecture is what makes stacking cheap.** Almost everything operates on a map's immediate `UpperMap()`/`LowerMap()` and chains through the per-map linked list; `MapByLevel` (on the ground controller) holds the whole column for column-wide queries. Stacking mostly "just works" through the chain.
- **Ledge shrinks per level (USER REQUEST).** GenStep_ABSkyTerrain projects the mountain mass from the level DIRECTLY BELOW the one being generated, not always the surface — so each step up erodes the mountain inward one more ring, forming a shrinking ziggurat. Because vertical links are wired AFTER map generation, LowerMap() is still null during the genstep; the below map is passed through `LevelMapGen.Context.belowMap` (= sourceMap, the level climbed from). Falls back to GroundMap() for the first sky level (they're the same there).
- **Per-level sky ticks generalized** in LevelComp from `level == 1` to `level > 0`: weather sync, time-sliced rooftop sweep, load-time ReconcileRooftops, TrySubscribeSync (roof/terrain/spawn mirror + ceiling nudge), NoteSkyLevel/AnySkyLevels counting. Each sky level mirrors weather/temperature/rooftops from its immediate lower neighbour, so state propagates up the stack transitively. ClimatePatches.SkyGroundOrNull generalized `level != 1` -> `level <= 0`.
- **See-below renderer needs no change**: every SectionLayer already resolves `map.LowerMap()`, so +2 renders +1, +1 renders surface. One hop deep, cost only when a sky map is current. The below-mesh mirror (LevelSync.OnLowerMeshDirty via RenderPatches) chains +1->+2 with no recursion (flag + no-upper-map guards).
- **Vanilla power self-bridges per pair already** (CompABGridLink, master = lower map uniqueID, reads `stairs.Counterpart`), so +1<->+2 power crossed automatically with NO change.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (whole-column bridging)
- **Bridging enumeration generalized for the stack.** ABPipeCompat.TickGroundPairs and LevelClimate.TickGroundPairs (driven once from the ground comp) previously iterated only `groundComp.Stairs`, which would MISS a pair living entirely above the ground (e.g. +1<->+2). They now call `LevelComp.CollectColumnStairs` (walks MapByLevel, allocation-free into a static buffer) and bridge each pair EXACTLY ONCE from its lower end (guard: skip when `b.Map.Level() <= a.Map.Level()`). The ground-branch early-return in MapComponentTick also keeps driving when `HasMultiLevels` even if the ground map holds no stairs (deconstructed-ground-stair edge case).
- Vanilla power — vertical conduit (CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader); VEF PipeSystem duct (VPE/Helixien/VTE); DBH vertical water pipe; Rimefeller vertical chem pipe (USER-VERIFIED). Dispatcher ABPipeCompat with ABDetect flags, per-def ext routing.

## Sky surface model (VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + time-sliced sweep. Rooftop renders the vanilla steel tile tinted dark steel to the outer wall edge; full buildability. Mountain edge maps below natural-roof rock to AB_MountainTop. Sky auto-roof guard on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.

## See-below renderer + level view/camera — ALL USER-VERIFIED
- Things PRINTED PER CELL (SectionLayer_ABBelowThings), covered cells print nothing. Faux-perspective depth transform, slab-edge skirt, fake zoom out (belowThingScale), rooftop rim wall reveal, slab-edge wall facade (clipped-sliver). Zero cost when the sky map is not current.
- LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView keeps camera pos+zoom (PageUp/PageDown, widget buttons, ride gizmos — all immediate-neighbour, chains naturally). ABArchitectPreserve keeps the open build tool across switches (BUG2). LevelCamera.FollowPawn rides a selected colonist through stairs (BUG3, toggle cameraFollowStairs).

## Column-wide aggregations (generalized to the whole stack)
- Storyteller **wealth** and **pawns** (ColumnWorld), **trade** beacon listings + debt drain (ColumnTrade), and **settlement-loss** headcount (SettlementLossGuard) previously summed only `upperMap + lowerMap`; all now iterate `LevelComp.LinkedLevelMaps()` (every live map in the column except ground). This keeps the wealth-hiding exploit closed and lets +2/+3 goods sell — regardless of how many sky levels the player enabled.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker. Cross-level SUPPLY FETCH (crossLevelSupply). NEEDS across the column: rest/food/RECREATION; ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver. Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders. Cross-level PRISONER TRANSPORT (crossLevelPrisoners).
- **Cross-level logistics stay SINGLE-HOP (per-pawn immediate neighbours).** Work/haul/needs/medical/prisoners/caravan-listing operate on the pawn's OWN map's upperMap/lowerMap, so reach chains one level per pawn location (ground<->+1, +1<->+2, +2<->+3, ground<->basement) but a ground colonist will NOT directly service +2. Caravan listing intentionally lists only the two adjacent levels (descent is single-hop; a +2 colonist walks down manually). This is the recommended v1 behavior and preserves the existing perf protections.

## Performance architecture
- ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling. Hidden-level throttling; faux-perspective one lazy rebuild. Bridges run once from the ground comp over a reused buffer. Zero recurring cost with no levels. **TPS with stacking is LINEAR in map count** — each extra sky level is one more full simulated Map (temperature/weather/regions/plants/AI tick even when idle), same order as vanilla multi-map; the mod's own systems add no quadratic term.

## Mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH, Rimefeller (USER-VERIFIED), Open The Windows, Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver. XML: ABStairsExtension; ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; async mask lag; freestanding unroofed walls below visible from above.
- Construction: building over natural rock rejected everywhere (vanilla lock) — mine rooms first.
- Cross-level logistics single-hop; caravan lists only adjacent levels; +2/+3 colonists walk down manually to caravan.
- Each enabled sky level is a full map's tick cost even when empty.
- DBH sewage per-level; VEF turn-on cascade; hidden sky weather lag.

## Status
2026-07-20: NEW configurable 1-3 sky levels shipped and building green — per-level ledge shrink (belowMap in gen context), LevelComp sky ticks generalized to level>0, whole-column utility bridging (CollectColumnStairs + bridge-once-from-lower-end), and column aggregations (wealth/pawns/trade/loss) generalized to LinkedLevelMaps. Default maxUpperLevels=1 preserves prior behavior. NOT YET PLAYTESTED at 2+ sky levels — needs in-game verification of ledge stacking, +1<->+2 utility bridging, and multi-level TPS. Prior verified items (see-below renderer, level UI, supply fetch, prisoner transport, Rimefeller compat, BUG2/BUG3) unchanged. Open: playtest stacking; T9 soak; T5 publishing prep.
